args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing the first week when created early
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly case immediately advances `next` by 7 days without checking whether `next` is strictly after `from` (unlike the daily case, which checks `if (next <= from)`). Update the weekly cadence calculation to check whether `next <= from` and advance by 7 days only if it has already passed, so schedules created before the run hour on the same day correctly target that day.
